Fair ternary affine failures inherit a conditional #BIS barrier; overlap sampling faces a stronger known NFA baseline For explicitly supplied affine equations a_e dot x=b_e over F_2 and independent exact rational retention probabilities p_e, U is the probability the retained equations are inconsistent. The source supplies complete elementary reductions showing that an FPRAS for distinct fair-retained equations of arity at most three would yield an FPRAS for #BIS, conditional on the stated Feng–Fu–Guo two-terminal-unreliability theorem. This is an approximation-preserving implication, not unconditional impossibility of an FPRAS. Matrix construction, accuracy/confidence encodings and output bit costs are charged. Empirical probability calibration and justification of independence are outside the supplied computational model.

A binary cographic cycle-space representation translates terminal disconnection into span membership, then affine inconsistency. Private prefix-parity helpers reduce arity. Removing independent helpers only relaxes constraints, while the all-helpers-survive event multiplies U; this gives a relative bound without dividing by a rarity floor. Private-variable fair gadgets make rows distinct and simulate near-certain helper retention with polynomial amplification. The final scope is arity AT MOST three, not a silent promise that every equation has exactly three variables. S5 preserves an alternative initial reconstruction with the same imported hardness premise.

Let C be all contradictory supports c, Q=sum_(c in C) product_(e in c) p_e, and W(S) their number inside S. On inconsistent S, W(S)=2^(|S|-rank A_S-1). The source proves U<=Q<=U product_e(1+p_e). Sample a witness with weight proportional to product p_e, force its support retained, draw all other bits from the original law, and correct by 1/W(S). This produces an unbiased estimate after multiplying by Q. Q alone counts overlapping witnesses and is not a probability estimate; connected rank-one examples have exponential Q/U.

For a supplied row order, feasible augmented syndrome states have width w=max_j[rank(prefix)+rank(suffix)-rank(all)]. Gaussian elimination builds affine intersections; O(m2^w) state enumeration is charged and an optimal ordering is not acquired for free. With k=m-rank A, R=min{2^(k-1),product(1+p_e)}, the direct estimator uses O(R epsilon^-2 log(1/delta)) samples after exact endpoint/zero preprocessing. Integer tables, reciprocal-power-of-two outputs, all rank work, capped rational coins and the full worst-case bit bound (6.2) are explicit. Abort/failure is coupled to an ideal sampler; conditioning on no abort is not called independence. Disjoint dependency blocks combine with the same relative error and a confidence union bound.

The established Arenas–Croquevielle–Jayaram–Riveros #NFA FPRAS applies to the constructed witness NFA, counting accepted retention WORDS once rather than accepting runs. Rational-probability dyadic threshold encoding preserves relative error with charged bits. It gives low-width tractability WITHOUT the direct estimator's small-mass promise. The claimed new low-width/low-mass tractability boundary is WITHDRAWN. No full feasible-trellis implementation or matched modern #NFA benchmark was completed. Finite low-rank checks, the tiny-probability toy and informed internal cross-audits are producer evidence, not a practical advantage or external proof.

Family fit: N715 is signed graph/arity-two saturated entailment, while this card treats general affine retention and an arity-three boundary; N715 remains unreviewed and is not adopted, invalidated or extended. N719 treats continuous exponential DAG durations via a different NFA construction. Shared rare-event terminology establishes no transfer. Exact overlap-inequality priority, imported-theorem interface and useful representation/runtime gain remain open.

## 1. Exact input and output contract

The input is a list of \(m\) binary affine equations

\[
a_e\cdot x=b_e,\qquad a_e\in\mathbb F_2^d,\quad b_e\in\mathbb F_2,
\]

and explicitly supplied rational retention probabilities \(p_e\in[0,1]\). Retention bits are promised independent. Let \(S\subseteq[m]\) be the retained index set and

\[
U=\Pr[A_Sx=b_S\text{ is inconsistent}].
\]

Write \(B\) for the sum of binary numerator/denominator encoding lengths, and take the instance length \(L\) to include the matrix, right sides, probabilities, and dimensions. For rational \(\epsilon,\delta\in(0,1)\), write \(E_\epsilon,E_\delta\) for their binary numerator/denominator encoding lengths; the full input length is \(L+E_\epsilon+E_\delta\). The requested output is a rational \(\widehat U\) satisfying

\[
\Pr[(1-\epsilon)U\le\widehat U\le(1+\epsilon)U]\ge1-\delta.
\]

The output is zero exactly in the preprocessed zero case. All Gaussian elimination, representation construction, probability arithmetic, random-bit generation and output writing are charged. No rare-event conditional-sampling oracle is supplied. Physical acquisition/calibration of failure probabilities and evidence for the independence promise are outside this purely computational input contract.

Remove probability-zero rows. Solve the probability-one subsystem by Gaussian elimination. If it is inconsistent, return one. Otherwise find a particular solution \(x_0\) and a matrix \(N\) whose columns form a basis of its homogeneous nullspace. Substitute \(x=x_0+Nz\) into every remaining row:

\[
a'_e=a_eN,\qquad b'_e=b_e+a_ex_0.
\]

This preserves consistency for each retained subset and preserves the original independent retention law. Drop tautological rows \(0=0\). A row \(0=1\) remains a valid random contradiction. Thus the algorithmic proofs may assume \(0<p_e<1\), with all endpoint costs already charged. Testing the full remaining system detects \(U=0\): inconsistency is increasing, and every subset of the positive-probability rows has positive product mass.
